fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link/pubDate/image fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

alternativeHeadline.title: Alternative headline
alternativeHeadline.description: Secondary headline variant, as emitted upstream.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD, truncated with '...' by the CMS).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, when present on the upstream JSON-LD NewsArticle node.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough object -- name is usually the generic 'MPost' desk byline, not a named reporter).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object (article-mode) or lead image URL string (latest-mode from the sitemap's image:loc).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Article section/category, e.g. Business, Nation, Bengal.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords string as emitted upstream (frequently empty on this CMS).

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted in the JSON-LD block.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: news:publication_date from the sitemap, ISO 8601 with +05:30 (IST) offset (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
